title: A reusable-bowl trial
paragraphs: A night market committee tested reusable bowls at six food stalls. Customers paid a small deposit, collected their meal and returned the empty bowl to one of two washing points. The committee counted both borrowed and returned bowls each evening.

During the first week, the return rate was lower at the washing point near the market entrance. Volunteers initially assumed that its location was inconvenient. After speaking with customers, however, they learned that the return sign was partly hidden behind a drinks menu.

The committee moved the sign and repeated the trial for another week. Returns rose at that washing point, although some bowls were still taken home. The organisers concluded that clear instructions improved the system, but they did not claim that signs alone could prevent every loss.
